title: Retry production deployment and record updated production URL

requirements.summary: Document the production redeploy retry flow and how to capture/share the resulting public URL or actionable error details.
acceptanceCriteria: A new production deployment attempt is executed for the latest code.
If deployment succeeds, a public production URL is produced and shared as the result of the deployment.
If deployment fails again, capture and surface the deployment error details so the failure cause is actionable.

file_operations.description: Update the deployment guide to explicitly cover (1) how to retry a production deployment using the platform flow, (2) where to find/copy the resulting public production URL after success, and (3) what error output/log details to capture and share when a deployment fails so the cause is actionable (no code/feature changes).

requirements.summary: Replace the placeholder production URL and timestamp in frontend/PRODUCTION_URL.txt after successful deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/PRODUCTION_URL.txt contains the real production URL (not the placeholder).
frontend/PRODUCTION_URL.txt contains a filled-in 'Last Updated' timestamp (not the placeholder).

file_operations.description: After a successful production deployment, replace the placeholder 'URL: [To be updated after deployment]' with the actual public production URL, and replace the placeholder 'Last Updated: [Timestamp will be added after deployment]' with the real update time (English text only).
